source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The address-book, message-reader and search-window browser manifests each set mail.rights.override=true. This extends the explicit test baseline to these three harnesses. The patch changes configuration, adds no result assertion and does not prove the reported focus/empty-menu failures are eliminated. The earlier extension-harness lesson supplies the same checked notification consumer; its separate XUL-store reset is not added by this patch.
title: Three more browser-test harnesses explicitly suppress the rights notification
